summary: Iteration 4 retest of the iteration-3 fixes plus a quick regression at iPad size (1180x820). Backend: new test_enavlog_iter4.py, 11/11 pass; regression iter2+iter3, 21/21 pass. Frontend: every listed fix verified. I found and fixed one CRITICAL crash: typing an invalid ATA (or a non-numeric FOB or landing rate) got a 422 from the server, and FlightProcessPage then passed FastAPI's detail array straight to toast.error. React crashed with 'Objects are not valid as a React child' and the page went blank. Fixed in call(); with the fix, a readable error toast appears and the page keeps working.

minor.issue: pax_count and cargo are not checked to be numbers (any string is accepted)
A negative arrival_fob (e.g. '-5') is accepted; only landing_rate should allow a sign

Works on closed flights: it silently reopens the flight and wipes a locked logbook entry (no 409). The Reset button in FlightHero is outside the locked fieldset, so it is still active when the flight is closed

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: a 422 response crashed the page (React tried to render the detail array). This happened for an invalid navlog ATA, a non-numeric FOB ('abc' becomes 'null' via toOfp) and a landing rate like '1-2'
No client-side HH:MM or number check (unlike EventTile and CountdownTile); invalid input only fails on the server. After the error, the invalid text stays in the input
After the invalid-time toast, the invalid text (e.g. '25:99') stays in the TSAT input instead of going back to the saved value

issues: Disabled buttons (the gradient 'Update to now' / NOW tiles, landing presets) keep full colour and opacity; only inputs fade (disabled:[&_input]:opacity-60). Add disabled opacity and a not-allowed cursor to buttons
The 'Fuel deviation' card is always green, even at -67,908 LB with MAYDAY FUEL; it should turn amber or red for a negative deviation

action_items: Review the tester's fix in FlightProcessPage.jsx call() (normalises a 422 detail array into a message) and use the same pattern for any other toast.error(e.response.data.detail) calls
Add client-side HH:MM checks to the navlog ATA input and number checks to FOB / arrival FOB (toOfp('abc') currently sends the string 'null')
Put the invalid text back to the saved value after an invalid-time toast
Block reset on closed flights (return 409 in the backend and disable the hero Reset button when status is closed)
Give disabled buttons a visible disabled style in locked phases; colour the Fuel deviation card by its sign
Optional: check that pax_count and cargo are numbers; reject a negative arrival_fob

NavlogTable FOB onBlur: String(u.toOfp('abc')) gives 'null' and sends it to the API
The hero Reset/Delete buttons are outside the locked fieldset; Reset can wipe a closed logbook entry

rca of the issue: Blank-page crash: in FlightProcessPage.call(), the catch block ran toast.error(e.response?.data?.detail). For a Pydantic 422, detail is an array of {type, loc, msg, input, ctx, url}. Sonner rendered it as a React child, which threw and unmounted the tree. Reproduce: open the Enroute step, type 25:99 into ata-input-MERIT-0 and blur; the page goes blank. Fix: if detail is an array, join the msg fields (applied). Re-verified: the toast reads 'Time must be HH:MM (UTC)' and the page keeps working.
